answer.answer: MGNREGA provides at least 100 days of guaranteed wage employment in a financial year to every rural household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled work [E01]. The Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana Gramin (PMAY-G), another programme from the Ministry of Rural Development, supplies pucca houses to rural households [E03].
